overview: The Medford School Committee approved seven district policies and received updates on COVID-19 testing, special education programs, and the Massachusetts Family School Partnership Initiative. Members also heard a municipal financial presentation forecasting a fiscal year 2022 deficit and voted to schedule a capital improvement planning meeting.

items.title: Executive Session
items.summary: Voted to enter executive session to discuss a Teamsters collective bargaining grievance and pending MCAD litigation.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved the regular meeting minutes of February 8, 2021.

items.title: Report of the Secretary
items.summary: Received a brief update that nightly voting tally sheets will be sent to the committee.

items.title: Rules, Policy and Equity Subcommittee Policies
items.summary: Approved seven policies regarding equal educational opportunities, homeless students, military children, foster children, staff gift solicitations, crowdfunding, and an amended annual reporting schedule.

items.title: Special Education and Behavioral Health Subcommittee Report
items.summary: Approved the subcommittee report covering the high school Common Ground inclusion program, potential middle school expansion, and student behavioral health needs.

items.title: Community Participation
items.summary: Noted that no public comments were submitted by email.

items.title: Superintendent's Updates
items.summary: Heard updates on student athletics resuming, the Mustang Unity Poetry Contest, the high school Ethics Bowl team, upcoming grade-level listening sessions, and kindergarten information sessions.

items.title: COVID-19 Public Health and Testing Update
items.summary: Received a briefing on declining citywide positivity rates, ongoing in-school pooled testing results, and district alignment with CDC guidance.

items.title: Financial Update for the City of Medford
items.summary: Voted to request a copy of the CFO's report following a presentation warning of a projected $5 million to $8 million municipal deficit for fiscal year 2022 and addressing the accounting of previous supplemental state aid.

items.title: Massachusetts Family School Partnership Initiative
items.summary: Approved the report announcing Medford's selection as one of four districts participating in DESE's Family School Partnership Initiative.

items.title: Restroom Renovations and Capital Planning Resolution
items.summary: Approved an amended resolution to hold a capital improvement planning meeting to evaluate priorities and allocate $816,000 in capital funds toward high school restrooms and other urgent facility needs.

items.title: Condolence Resolution
items.summary: Adopted a resolution offering condolences to the family of former school department employee Barbara Scopa.
